name: Tsuioku no Mukougawa
source:
First-year highschooler Sagano Kazumi is a petite member of the basketball club, when he's suddenly thrust from his basketball-obsessed days into a life of being the charismatic student council president's plaything.
But it's through this that Kazumi begins to realise what's truly important, that he didn't notice in his previous lifestyle...

[Translated from the [url=http://cyberfan.jp/tsuioku/story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
高中一年级学生嵯峨野和巳身材娇小，是篮球社成员。他原本满脑子只有篮球，却突然被迫成为那位魅力出众的学生会长手中的玩物。
但也正是在这段经历中，和巳开始意识到，自己过去的生活里忽略了什么才是真正重要的事……

[译自[url=http://cyberfan.jp/tsuioku/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
